name: Zenlabs Ethica Limited
summary: Zenlabs Ethica Limited operates as a pharmaceutical firm specializing in the commerce of medicinal goods. Its extensive product range covers numerous therapeutic categories, including but not limited to pain management and anti-inflammatory drugs, dermatological applications, treatments for neurological disorders, specialized ear, eye, and nasal drops, anti-diabetic and antidepressant medications, antivirals, anti-emetics, various steroids, antihypertensive compounds, anti-allergy and cold remedies, cough syrups, nutritional supplements, digestive aids such as antacids and enzymes, appetite stimulants, traditional Ayurvedic formulations, and solutions for gastrointestinal ailments. The company was founded on July 20, 1993, and maintains its headquarters in Chandigarh, India.
